info.name: Submit a document for text extraction

params.name: mode
params.description: Extraction mode.

params.name: output_mode
params.description: Output formatting mode.

params.name: page_seperator
params.description: Page delimiter string inserted between pages.

params.name: pages_to_extract
params.description: Pages to extract, e.g. "1-5,7,21-".

params.name: median_filter_size
params.description: Median filter size for low_cost mode noise removal.

params.name: gaussian_blur_radius
params.description: Gaussian blur radius for low_cost mode noise removal.

params.name: line_splitter_tolerance
params.description: Baseline factor for line splitting (fraction of line height).

params.name: line_splitter_strategy
params.description: Line splitting strategy.

params.name: horizontal_stretch_factor
params.description: Horizontal stretch factor for multi-column layout adjustment.

params.name: url_in_post
params.description: When true, the request body is a document URL instead of binary data.

params.name: mark_vertical_lines
params.description: Reproduce vertical layout lines in the output.

params.name: mark_horizontal_lines
params.description: Reproduce horizontal layout lines in the output.

params.name: lang
params.description: Language hint for OCR (ISO 639-2/B, e.g. eng).

params.name: tag
params.description: Auditing label associated with the request.

params.name: file_name
params.description: Auditing reference file name.

params.name: use_webhook
params.description: Name of a registered webhook to deliver the result to.

params.name: webhook_metadata
params.description: Metadata echoed back to the webhook with the result.

params.name: add_line_nos
params.description: Enable line numbering and persist line metadata for highlights.

params.name: allow_rotated_text
params.description: Include rotated/angled text in extraction.

params.name: word_confidence_threshold
params.description: OCR word confidence filter (0-1).

items.docs: Converts a document to text. Accepts the raw document as binary (application/octet-stream) or, when url_in_post is true, a URL in the request body. Processing is asynchronous; a whisper_hash is returned to track and retrieve the job.
